LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel_Tip: Accumulation reduces work speed and speeds up natural depravity decay. Costs pause without a map or caravan, or while a full batch awaits delivery. The first eligible orgasm per encounter boosts progress; a full batch still uses the opportunity. Disabling preserves progress.
LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel_AnusRequired: Requires a present anus with 100% development.
